questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: That the university in Rotterdam had a study called Communication and Media, which I found to be relevant for my study in Communication and IT

Additional comments:

Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: I found it to be easy, but I think it helped me being a girl from Denmark. But I found my place in a Facebook group so I would recommend that for others too.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: That you need to be more open I terms of meeting up with people. I my case I liked living off campus, as it enabled me to adapt more into the culture in the netherlands and also get to know the roommates I lived with.

questions.answer: I had to register for my courses and then after that register for what class I wanted to be in

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: You had a meeting before going there as well as information on the website. Furthermore, you were able to contact the exchange office.

questions.answer: Read the information, and keep up with the deadlines.

Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: I found some courses to be very difficult and others to be relatively easy

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: I didn't like that everything was mandatory, as well as the exam forms. At UCPH they rely on you as a student and adult to keep up with your studies, I often felt like a child in collage when I went to Rotterdam
